items.q: Oh, Pres was in that band. That was a great band. And when Count took it over.

ctx.x: Oh, a lot of great Musicians that -- Big Joe Page, the bass, --

Oh, Pres was in that band. That was a great band. And when Count took it over. He wanted to come to Chicago, and Fletcher was instrumental in getting Count in the Grand Terrace. Buck Clayton, the trumpet player, was in that band --Harry and Sweets Edison. Oh, man, those are legends, those guys. And when Fletcher went out on the road, Ed Fox's Grand Terrace was the popular club in Chicago, and Fletcher recommended Basie to this gentleman that owned the club, and went in there and did a terrific Basie was a man…
